evidence.note: The barbecue's main cooking lid is closed.
A hand is visibly lifting the main lid.
The cooking lid is fully open, exposing the grates.
The main lid is closed again after a hand holds it at frame 368.

evidence.note: The plain folding side shelf is stowed against the grill.
The user reaches toward the shelf mechanism.
The broad plain metal shelf is extended horizontally.
The shelf appears folded back against the grill after the repositioning sequence.

events.object_description: Plain folding side shelf of the barbecue

evidence.note: The opposite side panel is not visibly extended in the frontal view.
The user approaches and grasps the red-labeled side shelf/panel.
The red-labeled side shelf is visibly extended beside the grill.
The extended shelf is no longer visible and appears returned to its stowed position.

events.object_description: Red-labeled folding side shelf or side-burner panel of the barbecue

notes: Five distinct localized manipulation episodes are visible. The final shelf episode is less certain because severe camera roll makes the panel's folded-versus-horizontal orientation difficult to judge.
scene_description: A first-person camera surveys an apartment balcony containing a white adjustable chaise lounge and a stainless-steel barbecue. The user raises and lowers the chaise backrest, then manipulates the grill's main lid, lower propane cabinet, and two side panels/shelves.
